premise_checks: USER PREMISE CHECK: "Bina 7.8 -> 11 MMTPA with a 1.2 Mt/y dual-feed cracker" - confirmed (BPCL AR 2023-24/2024-25). It is a steam ethylene cracker (DFCU), not an FCC; Bina has no FCC unit (HCU + DCU only). The propylene/PP linkage is Kochi (PFCC revamp + 400 KTPA PP) and Bina (550 KTPA PP fed from the cracker).
"Kochi PFCC/polypropylene" - confirmed: 400 KTPA PP with PFCC revamp, Rs 4,460 crore, due Oct/Dec 2027.
